title: Letter to Church Officers in Clay County, Missouri, 31 August 1835
source_note: JS, Oliver Cowdery, Sidney Rigdon, Frederick G. Williams, William W. Phelps, and John Whitmer, Letter, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to church officers, Clay Co., MO, 31 Aug. 1835. Retained copy, [between May 1837 and Mar. 1838], in John Whitmer, History, 1831–ca. 1847, pp. 77–81; handwriting of John Whitmer; CHL. For more complete source information, see the source note for John Whitmer, History.
